description: Room rent charge of ₹9,500/night exceeds policy sub-limit of ₹5,000/night.

note.text: [Policy/Clause-1] "The daily room rent, nursing, and boarding charges admissible under this policy shall not exceed ₹5,000 per day."

input.valueString: Apply proportionate room rent deduction of ₹4,500/night or collect differential copay from patient.
